close_rule: NO_TIME_BASED_FORCED_CLOSE; close on coherent milestone, true human/security/platform gate, or explicit user stop.

crash_windows.window: after START ack before close intent
crash_windows.recovery: resume from durable work checkpoint; do not invent a time-based END
send exactly one human explanatory END using delivery key

crash_windows.window: after Gmail END send before GitHub receipt
crash_windows.recovery: search same Gmail thread/delivery key; persist ACK; do not resend
reconcile to one authoritative active tranche and record the others as absorbed/superseded

security_invariants: final ChatGPT closeout is blocked until Gmail END provider ACK is durable
new work cannot reuse a CLOSED tranche
human APK delivery exposes one authorized install file only
Gmail APK attachments are forbidden; Drive is the installer transport
START/END emails are natural explanatory French and carry the same substantive story as chat
active work is not terminated merely because a clock duration elapsed
